sections.title: NCLEX Test-Taking Strategies
sections.content: Apply these core principles when analyzing clinical scenarios and selecting the best nursing action. While this tool tracks your manual study sessions, remember to apply these rules to every question.
bullets: Nursing Process: Always assess before intervening, unless the patient is in acute distress and the intervention is an immediate life-saving measure.
ABCs: Prioritize Airway, Breathing, and Circulation issues before addressing other physiological needs.
Maslow's Hierarchy: Prioritize physiological needs (pain, elimination, nutrition) over psychosocial needs.
Safety First: Choose the action that best prevents immediate harm to the patient.
Expected vs. Unexpected: Differentiate between expected symptoms of a disease process and unexpected complications that require immediate provider notification.

disclaimer: This tool is for educational study tracking only. It does not predict official NCLEX results, replace adaptive testing environments, or generate AI questions. Always rely on approved nursing program resources.
